conceptZh: 麵：麥字旁加面，麥子磨粉做成的麵條；積木小隊拿到一根大得離譜的麵條，只好想辦法一起抬。
object: a squad of interlocking building bricks marching in line, with one single noodle as long as a rope and one tiny chopstick-sized fork
morph: the bricks wrestle with a comically oversized noodle and tiny fork, and the noodle coils into the strokes of 麵
creativeAngle: 積木小隊發現一根粗得像繩子的麵條，叉子卻小得像牙籤，大家手忙腳亂想辦法，麵條捲著捲著自己盤成麵字。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale warm-peach backdrop. Cast: a squad of five interlocking building bricks in red, blue, yellow, green and orange with little round eyes, who march in a line, stack themselves, and topple at the worst possible moment, plus one single golden noodle as thick as a rope and a tiny toothpick-sized fork. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 麵, drawn in saturated golden-brown strokes with a darker brown edge, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the five bricks march in single file, stop, and gape at a giant noodle lying across the floor, stretching all the way out of the frame. The first narrated 麵 lands as the red brick pokes the noodle with its tiny fork and the noodle gives a springy boing. 1.5-3.5s: the bricks heave together, stacking themselves into a wobbly tower of three to reach the noodle's end, while the yellow brick tries to twirl it on the tiny fork and gets wrapped up like a ball of yarn; the tower leans, sways, and tumbles in a tidy pile with the blue brick on top of the pile still holding the fork. The second narrated 麵 lands as the noodle, freed, coils up and swings into the strokes of 麵 across the center. 3.5-5.0s: the bricks scramble together, forming a bridge, and lift the glyph's last piece into place as the tiny fork pops loose and bounces the green brick sideways. As the word 麵條 is spoken, a long golden noodle drops from the top of the frame, dangling like a rope, and the orange brick slides down it. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and fully readable for the last 3 seconds while the five bricks line up beside it in a happy row and do a small wave from end to end, clicking in rhythm, all away from the strokes. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 麵、麵、麵條 (ㄇㄧㄢˋ、ㄇㄧㄢˋ、ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄊㄧㄠˊ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized building bricks only, no real people.
